summary: Frontend-only regression testing of the Bandeja Financiera refactor (CargarValidar.js 1600+ lines → 5 subcomponents under /components/bandeja). Logged in as admin (earauzt@gmail.com), navigated to /cargar. All 3 tabs render (Importar, Por revisar [badge 83], Historial). Dropzone visible + Gmail sync section visible with badges (Pendientes: 61, Aprobados: 0) and 'Sincronizar ahora' button. Tab switching preserves state (files/selections), no console errors related to missing imports/undefined props/hook deps in the bandeja subcomponents. GmailConsentDialog path verified (admin is already connected, so connect→consent flow not triggered live, but the component code path is exercised when !gmailStatus.connected). Forest Palette teal visible in sidebar highlight + primary buttons. No emojis in tab labels (phosphor icons only). ONE REGRESSION FOUND: BandejaStats component is imported in CargarValidar.js line 20 but NEVER RENDERED — the inline stats block (line 1056-1086) is gated on `activeTab === 'validate'` which is a dead tab value (tabs are now 'importar' | 'revisar' | 'historial'). Result: stats cards never appear on screen. The explicit feature to test 'BandejaStats renders at top showing pending/approved counts' FAILS.

ui_bugs.issue: BandejaStats cards are never rendered. Line 1056 still uses legacy condition `activeTab === 'validate'` (old tab id) but tabs are now 'importar' | 'revisar' | 'historial'. The imported BandejaStats component is not mounted anywhere. User-facing impact: stats (Pendientes / Duplicados / Aprobados / Por revisar $) never appear at the top of Bandeja Financiera.

Header shows TWO subtitle paragraphs ('Tus movimientos financieros en un solo lugar' AND 'Sube archivos y aprueba transacciones en un solo lugar'). One looks like a duplication left over from the refactor. Lines 1044-1045.

Dead code: bulk approve button on line 1047 is also gated on `activeTab === 'validate'` — never shown. selectedItems/handleBulkApprove/handleBulkAction/openDetailDialog/showBulkDialog/BulkActionDialog wiring is orphaned because TabPorRevisar uses reviewSelectedIds/handleReviewBulkApprove instead. The BulkActionDialog at line 1171 is mounted but never opened (setShowBulkDialog is never called).

issues: Missing stats cards row at top (BandejaStats not mounted) — page jumps straight from header to tabs, losing the summary overview mentioned in the refactor plan.

passed_tests: Por revisar tab shows badge count (83 pending unified items)
[data-testid='gmail-sync-section'] visible with [data-testid='gmail-pending-badge'] and [data-testid='gmail-sync-btn'] (admin already connected: 61 pending / 0 aprobados)
Switching tabs revisar → historial → importar preserves dropzone visibility (no remount issues)
No console errors from bandeja subcomponents (no undefined props, no missing imports, no hook-deps warnings)
No emojis in tab labels (phosphor icons only)
Forest Palette #0D9E82 applied (sidebar active item, primary Procesar Archivos button)

action_items: Mount BandejaStats component in CargarValidar.js — currently imported but unused. Replace the legacy inline block at lines 1055-1086 with <BandejaStats stats={stats} duplicatePairs={duplicatePairs} crossCanalCount={crossCanalCount} formatCurrency={formatCurrency} /> and remove the `activeTab === 'validate'` gate (or gate on activeTab === 'revisar' if intended to show only on review tab).
Remove duplicate subtitle paragraph on lines 1044-1045 of CargarValidar.js.

Clean up dead code tied to the old 'validate' tab: the bulk approve button at line 1047-1052, openDetailDialog/handleBulkApprove/showBulkDialog wiring, and decide whether BulkActionDialog (line 1171) should be triggered from TabPorRevisar or removed. Currently setShowBulkDialog is never called.

Optional: Verify detail/edit dialog (showDetailDialog) is still reachable — it was previously opened from the pending list but TabPorRevisar.jsx doesn't call openDetailDialog. Confirm whether row-level edit is an intended removal or a regression.
critical_code_review_comments: CargarValidar.js still ~1190 lines; refactor extracted the 3 tabs + stats + dialogs but left a large amount of orchestration/state in the parent. Consider extracting the detail dialog block (lines 816-993) and the duplicate dialog (995-1038) into BandejaDialogs.jsx to further reduce the parent file.

The refactor did NOT update the conditional gate `activeTab === 'validate'` (legacy value). Two blocks still reference it: stats grid + bulk approve button. Both are effectively disabled. This is the root-cause regression.

TabImportar receives 20+ props via prop drilling (selectedFiles, dragActive, loading, result, processingStatus, ~10 handlers, gmail* state). Consider useContext or a custom useBandeja() hook to simplify.

Many state setters that are used only inside the parent (setShowBulkDialog, setBulkCategory, setBulkSubcategory, setBulkAction, setSelectedItems) are now dead code because no child calls them. Remove to avoid confusion.
Gmail sync test: confirmed Button triggers POST /api/gmail/sync; no integration issue observed.
Accessibility: dialog titles and buttons have text labels. GmailConsentDialog has [data-testid='gmail-consent-confirm-btn'] — OK.

success_rate.frontend: ~85% (11/13 acceptance items pass; BandejaStats rendering + dead-code cleanup fail/pending)

context_for_next_testing_agent: The Bandeja refactor is functionally intact (tabs mount, props flow, Gmail section and dropzone work, state persists across tab switches). The only real regression is the legacy `activeTab === 'validate'` gate in CargarValidar.js which prevents BandejaStats AND the bulk-approve button from ever rendering. Fix: replace the inline stats block with <BandejaStats .../> and remove the dead 'validate' branch. After main agent fix, re-run the same Playwright flow: login admin → /cargar → verify 4 stats cards (Pendientes, Duplicados, Aprobados, Por revisar $) are visible above the tabs. Admin currently has 61 Gmail pending + statement pending transactions (badge shows 83 on Por revisar tab). TabPorRevisar/TabHistorial/TabImportar sub-components themselves have no wiring issues.
rca of the issue: During the refactor, the `activeTab` enum was renamed from {cargar,validate,historial} to {importar,revisar,historial} but two conditional blocks in CargarValidar.js (stats grid at line 1056 and bulk approve header button at line 1047) were not updated — they still test for the old 'validate' value, so the React conditional renders false forever. The imported BandejaStats component at line 20 was never wired into JSX. Reproduction: login as admin, open /cargar, observe: header + tabs render but NO stats cards appear above the tabs. Mitigation: (a) mount <BandejaStats .../> unconditionally (or gate on 'revisar'), (b) remove the now-dead `activeTab === 'validate'` branches.
